Alan Trammell

Position: Shortstop

Bats: Right  •  Throws: Right

6-0, 165lb (183cm, 74kg)

Born: February 21, 1958 in Garden Grove, CA us

Draft: Drafted by the Detroit Tigers in the 2nd round of the 1976 MLB June Amateur Draft from Kearny HS (San Diego, CA).

High School: Kearny HS (San Diego, CA)

Debut: September 9, 1977 (Age 19-200d, 13,893rd in major league history)
   vs. BOS 3 AB, 2 H, 0 HR, 0 RBI, 0 SB

Last Game: September 29, 1996 (Age 38-221d)
   vs. MIL 4 AB, 2 H, 0 HR, 1 RBI, 0 SB

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2018. (Voted by Modern Baseball Era Committee on 13/16 ballots)
   View Alan Trammell's Page at the Baseball Hall of Fame (plaque, photos, videos).

Rookie Status: Exceeded rookie limits during 1978 season

Agents: John Boggs & Associates

Full Name: Alan Stuart Trammell

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Alan Trammell?

Alan Trammell is 68 years old.

When was Alan Trammell born?

Alan Trammell was born on February 21, 1958.

Where was Alan Trammell born?

Alan Trammell was born in Garden Grove, CA.

How tall is Alan Trammell?

Alan Trammell is 6-0 (183 cm) tall.

How much did Alan Trammell weigh when playing?

Alan Trammell weighed 165 lbs (74 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Alan Trammell play?

Alan Trammell played 20 seasons.

Is Alan Trammell in the Hall of Fame?

Alan Trammell was elected into the Hall of Fame in 2018.

When was Alan Trammell drafted?

Alan Trammell was drafted by the Detroit Tigers in the 2nd round of the 1976 MLB June Amateur Draft from Kearny HS (San Diego, CA).

What position did Alan Trammell play?

Alan Trammell was a Shortstop.

How many hits did Alan Trammell have?

Alan Trammell had 2,365 hits over his career.

How many home runs did Alan Trammell have?

Alan Trammell had 185 home runs over his career.

What was Alan Trammell's average?

Alan Trammell had a .285 average over his career.

How many teams has Alan Trammell played for?

Alan Trammell played for 1 team, the Detroit Tigers.

How many World Series has Alan Trammell won?

Alan Trammell has won 1 World Series.

When did Alan Trammell retire?

Alan Trammell last played in 1996.
